claim: EV008 still classifies Effect.sleep as a mechanical test-clock-stall-risk unless forkChild is a syntactic ancestor of the sleep call. R1-004's controlledWait therefore misses a sleep that lives in a provided service method while the it.effect body forks the consumer and advances TestClock. Source-derived prediction; this review did not execute the test.
evidence: packages/tooling/tool/cli/test/yeet-pr-provenance.test.ts:178-207 builds delayedFileSystem.readDirectory as Effect.sleep("3 seconds").pipe(Effect.andThen(fs.readDirectory(...))) at L187-188, then forks service.detect at L194 and yields TestClock.adjust("2 seconds") at L195. samples.json row EV008:packages/tooling/tool/cli/test/yeet-pr-provenance.test.ts:188:sleep@14#1 is mechanization=detector class=test-clock-stall-risk. packages/tooling/tool/cli/src/commands/Lint/internal/EffectVitestDetectors.ts:307-328 controlledWait only treats Effect.forkChild/forkScoped/forkDetach ancestors of the wait; detectClockWait at L758-785 always emits EV008 when testClockMode and not liveClockFor. Pin contract: TestClock.adjust packages/effect/src/testing/TestClock.ts:507-508 and README Using the TestClock at packages/vitest/README.md:146-154 require forking the wait then adjusting, not a mechanical stall label.
proposedFix: When the enclosing it.effect callback both forks an Effect and calls TestClock.adjust/setTime, classify an Effect.sleep that is only reachable through that forked work as judgment (controlled-clock-wait-review), not mechanical stall. Keep mechanical EV008 for a directly yielded sleep with a sibling adjust (already covered by the sequential-sleep fixture).

claim: EV006 does not detect hand-rolled Option assertions that use getOrUndefined/getOrElse, and it does not treat @beep/utils/Option as Option provenance. SPEC EV006 is hand-rolled Option/Result/Exit assertions via expect. Four round-2 samples show the miss. Source-derived; no execution.
evidence: packages/foundation/ui-system/ui/test/FormWidgets.test.ts:3 imports { Option as O } from "effect" and L11 is expect(O.getOrUndefined(findCountryOption("US"))?.label).toBe("United States") with no EV006 row in samples.json (only EV011). packages/foundation/ui-system/brand/test/assets.test.ts:48-51 uses expect(O.getOrElse(content, () => "")).toContain(...). packages/workspace/server/test/WorkspaceVaultStore.test.ts:68 uses expect(O.getOrUndefined(configured.vaultRootPath)).toBe(vaultRootPath) while L59 O.isNone is flagged. packages/foundation/capability/langextract/test/Service.test.ts:14 imports @beep/utils/Option and L168 uses O.getOrUndefined(error.details). Detector fixtures at packages/tooling/tool/cli/test/effect-vitest-detectors.test.ts:94-97 and L296-299 only cover is*/some/none/succeed/fail.
proposedFix: Extend dataShapeCall to Option/Result getOrUndefined/getOrElse/getOrThrow (and keep expect/boolean-assertion callers). Add @beep/utils/Option to OPTION_MODULES. Add positive/negative fixtures for those members so isSome-only tests cannot regress.

SPEC EV010 is node:fs, BunFileSystem/NodeFileSystem layers, and os.tmpdir in tests whose subject only needs FileSystem. Leave Path, ChildProcessSpawner, and generic NodeServices/BunServices as Resource-lens residue or a different class, not platform-filesystem-candidate with an it.layer/MemoryFileSystem sketch.

claim: EV013 never sees for-of or for-in loops. collectSyntaxRoles records only ForStatement, WhileStatement, and DoStatement, so a retry/attempt for-of with Effect.sleep cannot become a candidate. SPEC EV013 is hand-rolled retry/attempt loops. Source-derived; no in-sample for-of retry, but the indexer and its oracle both omit ForOf.
evidence: packages/tooling/tool/cli/src/commands/Lint/internal/EffectVitestSyntax.ts:260-277 collectRole pushes ForStatement/WhileStatement/DoStatement only; loops is [...forLoops, ...whileLoops, ...doLoops]. detectRetryLoop at EffectVitestDetectors.ts:924-928 iterates imports.loops. Detector test at effect-vitest-detectors.test.ts:808-809 includes for (const item of items) and for (const name in names) while the independent visitor at L834-836 also omits ForOf/ForIn, so spans match by jointly ignoring them. Counterexample that cannot enter EV013: for (const attempt of retries) { yield* Effect.sleep("5 millis") }. The detected quality-scheduler loop at packages/tooling/tool/cli/test/quality-scheduler.test.ts:1092 is a C-style ForStatement, which is why EV013 fired there.
proposedFix: Record ForOfStatement and ForInStatement in loops, keep loopIsRetryCandidate, and add a for-of attempt/sleep positive plus a plain for-of consume(value) negative.
